title: NEXT F Block Contract Registry
description: Generated index of authoritative Phase 6 reusable Block Contract definitions.

schemas.name: Action Group
schemas.description: Reusable primary and secondary CTA group.
schemas.purpose: Prevents blocks from redefining CTA semantics and tracking destinations.

fields.description: Optional accessible label for a small supporting link.

validationRules.description: Action Group may be empty; the parent Block decides whether an action is required.
Primary and secondary actions should not duplicate the same label and destination without an explicit business reason.

requirements: CTA labels must describe the action or destination.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: CTA
schemas.description: Focused conversion call-to-action section.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes conversion copy and actions without encoding button styling in content.

fields.description: Optional primary and secondary conversion actions.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: A CTA section should normally include at least one actionable destination even though preview/draft states may be incomplete.

requirements: Actions must have clear accessible labels and visible focus states in the frontend.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Registered Custom Block
schemas.description: Escape hatch for a Site-specific structured Block contract registered by NEXT F.
schemas.purpose: Allows truly customer-specific sections without weakening the platform by permitting arbitrary HTML, CSS or JavaScript.

fields.description: Structured payload validated against the registered extension schema.

validationRules.description: extensionId and extensionVersion must resolve to a Site-authorized registered extension contract.
data must validate against that registered extension schema.
Extension payload must not contain executable JavaScript, unrestricted HTML/CSS or secrets.
Custom extensions must not redefine the semantics of an existing canonical NEXT F Block.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

notes: Use only when no canonical Block can express the business requirement.
Promote broadly reusable extensions into the canonical registry through the normal contract lifecycle.

schemas.name: Documents
schemas.description: Documentation/article listing block.
schemas.purpose: Allows approved documentation to be selected or queried without duplicating article content in page data.

fields.description: Documentation collection used by collection mode.
Documentation category used by category mode.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: Manual mode requires documents, collection mode requires collection, and category mode requires category.
Only public-eligible published documents may be rendered publicly.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: FAQ
schemas.description: FAQ section sourced from reusable FAQ entities.
schemas.purpose: Allows FAQs to be maintained once and reused while preserving structured question-and-answer semantics.

fields.description: FAQ group when selectionMode is group.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: Manual mode requires faqs; group mode requires a non-empty group.
Only eligible published FAQs may be delivered publicly.

requirements: Expandable FAQ controls must expose expanded/collapsed state to assistive technology.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Feature Grid
schemas.description: Grid/list of structured feature items.
schemas.purpose: Lets customers manage benefits and features while NEXT F controls card composition and responsive layout.

fields.description: Optional primary and secondary conversion actions.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every item validates against Feature Item.

validationRules.description: Every items entry must validate against blocks.featureItem.
Implementations may enforce lower display limits based on the selected approved variant.

requirements: Feature cards must preserve logical source order independent of responsive columns.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Feature Item
schemas.description: Reusable feature/card content item.
schemas.purpose: Provides one consistent feature-item structure for grids and future reusable components.

fields.description: Optional approved icon identifier from the Site implementation.

relationships.description: Feature may link to another destination.

validationRules.description: When iconKey is used it must resolve to an icon made available by the Site implementation; it must not contain raw SVG/HTML.

requirements: Decorative icons should be hidden from assistive technology unless they convey unique information.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Form
schemas.description: Form placement block that references the canonical Forms module when available.
schemas.purpose: Keeps form placement separate from form-definition logic and prevents page content from embedding arbitrary form scripts.

fields.description: Reference to the canonical form entity when Forms is enabled.
Optional contextual copy shown around a successful submission; the Form contract remains authoritative for submission behavior.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Uses an entity reference until the Forms contract becomes authoritative in Phase 8.

validationRules.description: When Phase 8 is active, form must reference an entity conforming to the canonical forms.form contract.
Arbitrary form HTML or third-party script snippets are prohibited in this block.

requirements: Referenced forms must provide programmatic labels, instructions, validation feedback and keyboard-operable controls.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Gallery
schemas.description: Structured media gallery section.
schemas.purpose: Allows editorial gallery management without exposing arbitrary slideshow or layout code.

fields.description: Whether the approved frontend may offer an expanded media view.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every gallery item validates against Gallery Item.

validationRules.description: Every items entry must validate against blocks.galleryItem.

requirements: Lightbox interaction must be keyboard accessible when enabled.
Expanded media UI must manage focus and provide a close control.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Gallery Item
schemas.description: Reusable gallery media item with optional contextual copy and destination.
schemas.purpose: Adds per-placement context around a canonical media asset without duplicating the asset.

relationships.description: May link to an approved destination.

requirements: Informative media must have meaningful alternative text through the media reference.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Section Heading
schemas.description: Reusable heading group for section-level blocks.
schemas.purpose: Keeps eyebrow, heading and description semantics consistent without forcing visual layout.

fields.description: Optional short contextual label above the heading.

validationRules.description: semanticLevel is controlled by NEXT F/developer configuration so customer edits cannot break heading hierarchy.

requirements: Rendered heading level must match semanticLevel.
Do not use visual size as a substitute for semantic heading order.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Hero
schemas.description: Primary introductory section for a page or landing experience.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes editable hero content while keeping layout, animation, responsive composition and visual treatment in the coded frontend.

fields.description: Optional primary and secondary conversion actions.
Optional concise supporting note such as availability or trust copy.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: When heading.semanticLevel is h1, the rendered page must not introduce another primary H1 unless the page contract explicitly permits it.
Non-null variantKey must be implemented and approved by the Site frontend.

requirements: Hero media must not replace the textual heading.
CTA labels must remain understandable outside their visual styling.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Locations
schemas.description: Business location listing sourced from reusable Business Location entities.
schemas.purpose: Provides location presentation without confusing business locations with hosting regions or infrastructure.

fields.description: Whether approved map/directions links may be shown when location data supports them.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: Manual mode requires locations.
Business Location records must never be interpreted as hosting/server regions.

requirements: Location information must remain available as text even when a map or visual representation is used.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Logo Grid
schemas.description: Structured collection of partner, customer, certification or technology logos.
schemas.purpose: Keeps logos and their names accessible while frontend controls grid presentation.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every item validates against Logo Item.

validationRules.description: Every items entry must validate against blocks.logoItem.

requirements: Logos that convey identity need appropriate text alternatives.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Logo Item
schemas.description: Reusable organization/partner/client logo item.
schemas.purpose: Keeps logo media, human-readable name and optional link together.

fields.description: Organization or brand name represented by the logo.

relationships.description: Uses a media reference for the logo.
May link to an organization website or related page.

requirements: Logo alternative text should identify the represented organization when the logo conveys content.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Pricing
schemas.description: Marketing pricing/package comparison section.
schemas.purpose: Provides controlled pricing presentation while keeping transactional ecommerce pricing in Commerce contracts.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every plan validates against Pricing Plan.

validationRules.description: Every plans entry must validate against blocks.pricingPlan.
Pricing Block data must not be used as the authoritative checkout price for Commerce transactions.

requirements: Pricing differences must be understandable in text, not only through color or highlighted cards.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Pricing Plan
schemas.description: Display-oriented pricing plan item for marketing pages.
schemas.purpose: Supports service/package price presentation without pretending to be a transactional commerce price or checkout contract.

fields.description: Optional merchandising badge such as Most Popular.
Display price text such as From LKR 25,000 or Contact us.
Optional billing-period text such as per month.
Whether the approved frontend may visually prioritize this plan.
Optional pricing qualification or terms note.

validationRules.description: priceLabel is display content and must not be used as an authoritative commerce checkout amount.
features must contain non-empty plain text strings only.

requirements: Pricing qualifications must remain available as text and not only through visual decoration.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Process / Steps
schemas.description: Ordered process, journey or timeline section.
schemas.purpose: Creates predictable step structures while frontend controls visual timeline treatment.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every step validates against Process Step.

validationRules.description: Every steps entry must validate against blocks.processStep.
Array order is the canonical logical sequence.

requirements: Rendered visual order must match the canonical logical step sequence.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Process Step
schemas.description: Reusable ordered process or timeline step.
schemas.purpose: Provides consistent step data for process, journey and timeline sections.

fields.description: Optional short step marker such as 01 or Discovery.

relationships.description: Step may link to supporting content.

requirements: Visual numbering must not be the only way step sequence is conveyed.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Related Content
schemas.description: Cross-content recommendation section using canonical entity references.
schemas.purpose: Provides structured related/recommended content without hardcoding duplicate card content.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every item validates against Related Content Item.

validationRules.description: Every items entry must validate against blocks.relatedContentItem.
Related items must belong to the same Site unless an explicit cross-site contract permits otherwise.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Related Content Item
schemas.description: Reference wrapper for content presented as related or recommended.
schemas.purpose: Allows related content to target different canonical content entities while keeping optional contextual overrides structured.

fields.description: Optional contextual title override without changing the target entity.

relationships.description: May override display media for this placement.

validationRules.description: When delivered publicly, the target entity must be public-eligible and published in the same Site unless an explicit contract permits otherwise.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Rich Text
schemas.description: Long-form structured editorial section.
schemas.purpose: Provides safe rich editorial content without arbitrary executable HTML.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: May include a separate section heading.

validationRules.description: content must use the canonical safe rich-content envelope and must not contain executable script semantics.

requirements: Heading nodes inside content must preserve logical hierarchy.
Links must have meaningful accessible labels.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Services
schemas.description: Service listing sourced from reusable Service entities.
schemas.purpose: Prevents service information from being duplicated across page sections and keeps selection behavior explicit.

fields.description: Optional primary and secondary conversion actions.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: selectionMode manual requires at least one services reference.
featured/all selection may include only eligible published services from the same Site.
Service references must remain within the same Site unless an explicit cross-site contract is introduced.

requirements: Service cards must have accessible names and destinations when clickable.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Stat Item
schemas.description: Reusable statistic or metric content item.
schemas.purpose: Allows human-readable metrics such as 99.9%, 24/7 and 250+ without forcing numeric-only storage.

fields.description: Optional prefix such as currency or approximation.
Optional suffix such as %, + or years.

validationRules.description: Values are editorial claims and must be backed by the Organization when they represent factual business performance.

requirements: Rendered text must make the relationship between value and label understandable without relying only on visual proximity.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Stats
schemas.description: Section presenting a set of business statistics or metrics.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes metric content while allowing frontend-specific visual presentation.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: Every metric validates against Stat Item.

validationRules.description: Every items entry must validate against blocks.statItem.

requirements: Do not communicate metric meaning only with color, iconography or animation.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Team
schemas.description: Team listing sourced from reusable Team Member entities.
schemas.purpose: Prevents team profile duplication and gives customers controlled member selection.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: Manual mode requires at least one member.
Only eligible published team profiles may be delivered publicly.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Testimonials
schemas.description: Testimonial listing sourced from reusable Testimonial entities.
schemas.purpose: Keeps testimonial claims reusable and avoids copied quote data across pages.

fields.description: Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: selectionMode manual requires at least one testimonial reference.
Public delivery includes only eligible published testimonials.

requirements: Auto-rotating presentation, if implemented, must provide pause/control behavior appropriate to accessibility requirements.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Text + Image
schemas.description: Combined structured copy and media section.
schemas.purpose: Supports common editorial layouts without letting customer content define arbitrary grid or CSS structure.

fields.description: Optional primary and secondary conversion actions.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

validationRules.description: mediaPositionKey is an approved layout hint; responsive behavior remains frontend-controlled.

requirements: Informative images require suitable alternative text.
Responsive visual reordering must not create an illogical reading order.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.

schemas.name: Video
schemas.description: Single video presentation with poster, caption and transcript support.
schemas.purpose: Provides a safe media-oriented video block without arbitrary embed HTML.

fields.description: Managed video asset when sourceType is media.
Approved external video URL when sourceType is external.
Optional developer-defined presentation variant key. This is not free-form styling.

relationships.description: May use managed video and poster assets.

validationRules.description: sourceType media requires media and must not require externalUrl; sourceType external requires externalUrl.
External video must use an approved URL/provider adapter; arbitrary iframe/embed HTML is prohibited.

requirements: Video controls must be keyboard accessible.
Captions should be provided for spoken content where required.
Transcript should be available for important spoken/informational content.

delivery.notes: Block data may be delivered only through an eligible published parent content entity.
